ESP Web Tools 10.4.0 with esptool-js pinned to 0.7.1 for ESP32-S31 detection
and its flash stub. Version label: 10.4.0-s31.1. All chips share this bundle.

Source archive SHA-256, dependency lock and output hashes are recorded under
`tools/web-tools/`. Rebuild using `python3 tools/build_web_tools.py`.
Apache-2.0; original Espressif/esptool-js dependency license is retained there.
